verdict.rationale: Pulley documents e-signature collection for SAFEs/board approvals without a third-party tool (pulley-docs-9) and notes that uploaded documents can be attached to specific securities (pulley-docs-1), suggesting some document-to-cap-table linkage, but no evidence specifically addresses issuing or e-signing electronic share certificates. Missing for 10: explicit share certificate issuance workflow, in-platform legal signing of certificates, and confirmation of permanent linkage to the specific cap table entry.
